name: Language-Specific Null and Missing Comparison Semantics
description: Exhaustive matrix of null equality, comparison, sorting, and truthiness behavior across SQL, Python, SAS, JavaScript, and Java.
when_to_retrieve: When evaluating boolean condition equivalence between source and target code containing nulls
when_not_to_retrieve: When variables are statically proven non-null
retrieval_guidance: Compare how each language evaluates: null == null, null < 0, bool(null), null in [1, 2].
